name: @hyperapi/driver-tasq
description: Driver for HyperAPI based on Tasq.

scripts.check: lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.redis:up: docker ps | grep test-redis >/dev/null || docker run --rm -d -p 16379:6379 --name test-redis redis:7-alpine
scripts.test: bun run redis:up && bun test && npm run test:vitest
scripts.test:vitest: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit false --outDir node_modules/.vitest-build && vitest run --dir node_modules/.vitest-build --no-file-parallelism

author: Daniil Kirichenko (https://twitter.com/kirickme)
